# Asha Garment Factory

> Asha Garment Factory (AGF) is an ethical OEM and private label garment manufacturer in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Founded in 2011, it produces women's, men's and kids wear for brands in the USA, UK, Switzerland, Qatar, UAE and India from a minimum of 100 pieces per style, and its profits support children's homes and single mothers in India.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2011
- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Minimum order quantity (MOQ): 100 pieces per style
- Sample development: about 3 weeks from tech pack, sketch or reference garment
- Bulk production lead time: 6–10 weeks after sample approval
- Quote turnaround: within 24 hours
- Services: OEM and private label clothing manufacturing; tech pack support; sampling; fabric and trims sourcing; cutting and stitching; in-house multi-head embroidery; screen printing and heat transfer; custom labels, hangtags and packaging; three-stage quality control (in-process, post-production, pre-shipment); export packing, documentation and logistics
- Product categories: women's wear (dresses, tops, blouses, casual wear); men's wear (shirts, t-shirts, polos, trousers); t-shirts (crew neck, V-neck, ringer, oversized, boxy) and polos; kids wear (tops, shorts, trousers, co-ord sets, school uniforms); lifestyle and activewear
- Export markets: USA, UK, Switzerland and Europe, Qatar, UAE and the Middle East
- Works with: established brands, startups and small brands
- Ethics: fair wages, fixed working hours, safe working conditions, fabric-waste reduction; profits fund children's homes and education for underprivileged children and skills training for single mothers
